Package com.mimecast.robin.smtp.security

Class SubmissionLimits

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.smtp.security.SubmissionLimits
public final class SubmissionLimits extends Object
Process-local authenticated principal/domain quotas, independent of peer IP. Attempts and uploaded bytes consume budget even if the transaction later fails.
